title: AI Image Generator (GAN)
tagline: Photorealistic images generated from a dataset, not a camera.

meta.title: AI Image Generator (GAN) | Foxtroit AI
meta.description: Photorealistic images generated from a dataset, not a camera.

blocks.title: The Problem
blocks.content: Producing realistic custom imagery normally takes real photography or illustration work, which is slow and doesn't scale with how many variations a brand needs.

blocks.title: The Solution
blocks.content: A GAN trained in PyTorch learns from a dataset and generates new high-quality images that resemble it, refined through image processing.

blocks.title: Outcome
blocks.content: Rapid exploration of visual styles and variations without commissioning new shoots for each one.
